description: Geometry helpers used by document page layout and object wrapping.

members.name: ClampToBody
members.description: Clamps a rectangle origin into the page body while preserving the rectangle size when possible.

members.name: ComputeWrapRect
members.description: Expands an object rectangle by the configured wrap distances.

members.name: CreateDefaultWrapContourPoints
members.description: Returns the default rectangular wrap contour in normalized object coordinates.

members.name: CreateExclusionZone
members.description: Creates a text exclusion zone for one object, or returns null when the wrap mode does not block text.

members.name: GetObjectFootprintRect
members.description: Returns the object's visible layout footprint, falling back to the media rectangle when no caption footprint exists.

members.name: Intersection
members.description: Returns the overlapping area of two rectangles, or an empty rectangle if they do not overlap.

members.name: Intersects
members.description: Returns whether two rectangles overlap with positive area.

members.name: NormalizeWrapContourPoints
members.description: Clamps wrap contour points to normalized coordinates and falls back to a rectangle when too few valid points are provided.

members.name: OrderByZIndex
members.description: Orders object boxes by page and z-index while preserving stable relative order for equal z-index values.

members.name: Union
members.description: Returns the smallest rectangle containing both input rectangles.
